title: Professor
department_or_school: Department of Nutrition Sciences, School of Health Professions (also Director, PhD program in Nutrition Sciences)
research_interests: biobehavioral mechanisms of pediatric obesity; in utero programming (maternal obesity, gestational diabetes) of child obesity and cardiometabolic risk; pregnancy and infancy as critical periods for obesity prevention; objective measurement of infant and early-childhood eating behavior
relevant_publication_1: Central Adiposity, Rather Than in Utero Exposure to Maternal Obesity or Gestational Diabetes, Predicts Metabolic Syndrome Risk in Children Aged 4-10 Years
research_fit_explanation: Her work on how maternal obesity and gestational diabetes in pregnancy shape children's obesity and cardiometabolic risk lines up with Sana's interests in maternal/pregnancy nutrition, childhood obesity and diabetes/metabolic health. Sana's final-year project assessing pregnant and diabetic patients and her glycemic-control product are relevant background. As PhD program director she is also the natural contact for questions about the UAB Nutrition Sciences PhD.
spring_2027_status: No spring admission - PhD admits fall term only (https://www.uab.edu/shp/nutrition/education/phd-in-nutrition-sciences/admissions)
fall_2027_status: Fall-only program; deadline December 1 per admissions page and UAB catalog (cycle year not stated on page; an older studentorgs.uab.edu mirror says February 1) (https://www.uab.edu/shp/nutrition/education/phd-in-nutrition-sciences/admissions)
application_deadline: December 1 (fall entry; year not stated on page - confirm it applies to Fall 2027)
funding_or_assistantship_evidence: Scholars@UAB grants page lists NIH/NICHD-funded projects starting 2025-12-09 (a childhood follow-up study of obesity and neurodevelopment after perinatal azithromycin exposure; a predictors of youth-onset type 2 diabetes clinical center project); her role (PI or not) on each is not stated (https://scholars.uab.edu/1845-paula-chandlerlaney/grants). No statement about open student positions seen.
eligibility_notes: UAB Graduate School minimum IELTS 6.5 overall / TOEFL 80, scores within 2 years (https://www.uab.edu/gradadmissions/apply/international-applicants); GRE not required and international application fee $60 (https://www.uab.edu/shp/nutrition/education/phd-in-nutrition-sciences/admissions)
